title: 10/1/2025 Daily Recap: QQQ SPY all time high

observed_trades.setup: Shaken out; today it took out yesterday's highs and continued higher without him.
observed_trades.stop: respected risk in real time; says he could have been five minutes more patient
observed_trades.quote: we talked about this yesterday. I got shaken out of Palunteer.
observed_trades.notes: Day of the shakeout inferred from 'we talked about this yesterday'; at 15:08 'getting stopped out of Palunteer'. No re-entry.

observed_trades.setup: Biggest position, highest close in the formation; no plans to do anything with it.
observed_trades.quote: continue to have this be my biggest position and it's only getting bigger.
observed_trades.notes: Tesla named just before the quote. At 07:13 'I still have my Tesla. No plans on doing with it'.

observed_trades.quote: ASML. I was trying to buy it down here and just no luck.
observed_trades.notes: Older attempt pointed at on the chart; date not given. Now at a new all-time high off a 20 SMA bounce.

observed_trades.quote: just no luck. You know, I had to cut it.
observed_trades.notes: Exit of the older ASML attempt; date not given.

observed_trades.setup: Bought off the 20-day; holds as long as it trends up the 20, no adds.
observed_trades.quote: I still have PDD. It's a little bit slow, but I bought this thing off of the 20

observed_trades.setup: New all-time closing high, slow grinder; added for semi exposure.
observed_trades.quote: I added a little bit more to my Nvidia today.
observed_trades.notes: At 02:07 'I do own Nvidia so that's nice'.

observed_trades.setup: Fairly big bounce back today; cut the position in half and will leave the rest unless it rejects the 200 SMA.
observed_trades.stop: rest managed against a rejection of the 200 SMA
observed_trades.quote: So I did cut down my position in half and I won't really mess with it

observed_trades.setup: Low cheat setup potentially ready for higher; working fine for him.
observed_trades.quote: Uh Microsoft just working fine for me.
observed_trades.notes: In his positions rundown; 'working fine for me' implies he holds it.

observed_trades.stop: will be done with the rest over 65
observed_trades.quote: NQ I covered half today very nicely might I add 61 and a half.
observed_trades.notes: Quote runs across 07:48 and 08:01. 'NQ' with a $61-74 price is a stock, likely IONQ (see ambiguous_tickers). Short entry around 74 implied by 'move from 74 to 61 and a half'.

observed_trades.setup: Bounce off a lower trend line as it started to turn back up; bought a bit late, closed fairly well.
observed_trades.entry_basis: turn up off lower trend line
observed_trades.quote: I picked up a little bit of GEV today off of this lower trend line

observed_trades.setup: No real opinion; holds while above the 20-day.
observed_trades.quote: So long as we stay above the 20, I will continue to let this thing work.
observed_trades.notes: In positions rundown; quote runs across 08:33 and 08:45. CCJ named in 08:33 block.

observed_trades.setup: New closing high effectively, steady all quarter.
observed_trades.quote: Arc as well, you know, new closing high effectively.
observed_trades.notes: Ownership inferred from the positions rundown ('I'm not going to complain with the action here'). 'Arc' decoded as ARKK.

observed_trades.setup: Bought as it turned back up off the 50 SMA, for more semi exposure beyond Nvidia.
observed_trades.quote: that I picked up today off of effectively the 50 simple moving
observed_trades.notes: ALAB named in the same 08:55 block.

observed_trades.setup: Pushed out well in the morning and seemed to be tightening within a big base; worked for about 20 minutes.
observed_trades.quote: I did try Rocket Lab today and it was working well

observed_trades.setup: Stopped once it broke into the red; won't hold red overnight in a ripping market.
observed_trades.stop: stop when the stock broke into the red on the day
observed_trades.quote: And I took my stop on this thing once we broke into the red.

observed_trades.setup: Owned it before and took a small loss; now ripping, back on watch.
observed_trades.quote: I've owned it before. I took a little bit of a loss on it
observed_trades.notes: Timing of the old trade not given in this video. Ticker as captioned 'AOI' (likely AAOI).
